name: Magadan
brief: A place on the Sea of Galilee; home of Mary Magdalene
short: Magadan (Dalmanutha), a place on the shore of the Sea of Galilee visited by Jesus (<ref="Matthew 15:39; Mrk.8.10">Matthew 15:39; Mrk.8.10</ref>), possibly the hometown of Mary Magdalene (<ref="Matthew 27:56, 61; 28:1; Mrk.15.40, 47; 16:1, 9; Luke 8:2; 24:10; Jhn.19.25; 20:1, 18">Matthew 27:56, 61; 28:1; Mrk.15.40, 47; 16:1, 9; Luke 8:2; 24:10; Jhn.19.25; 20:1, 18</ref>).
